title: RBI Imposes Rs 9 Lakh Penalty on One Mobikwik Systems Limited
description: RBI penalises One Mobikwik Systems Ltd with Rs 9 lakh for breaching prepaid payment instrument rules and missing fraud-reporting deadlines.

title: Bank holidays: SBI, HDFC Bank branches closed on 3 days between 16-22 Nov
description: SBI, HDFC and other Indian banks will shut physical branches for three days between Nov 16‑22, while digital channels stay open.

title: SEBI to unveil 2026 AI guidelines for Indian markets, protecting investors
description: SEBI will unveil 2026 AI guidelines for Indian markets, requiring AI model disclosure, human‑in‑the‑loop approval and monitoring to protect investors.

title: RBI 2026 DMT Directions cap cash payouts at ₹10,000 per transaction
description: The RBI's 2026 DMT Directions cap cash payouts at ₹10,000 per transaction and ₹25,000 monthly per beneficiary, effective now for all banks.

title: Reserve Bank of India sets 4% leverage ratio for D‑SIBs in 2026 amendment
description: The RBI's 2026 amendment sets a 4% leverage ratio for D‑SIBs and a 3.5% floor for other banks, effective 1 April 2027, aligning with Basel III.

title: SEBI panel to review IPO, FPO and QIP rules to simplify capital raising
description: SEBI's Primary Market Advisory Committee sub-group will review ICDR rules for IPOs, FPOs, and QIPs to simplify capital raising processes.

title: RBI reiterates listing mandate for Tata Sons, cites Rs 2.01 trillion assets
description: RBI orders Tata Sons, holding Rs 2.01 trillion in assets, to comply with mandatory listing rules after missing the September 2025 deadline.

title: RBI seeks review of SC ruling on YES Bank ₹8,415 cr AT‑1 bonds
description: RBI seeks review of Supreme Court ruling that upheld Bombay High Court order restoring YES Bank's ₹8,415 cr AT-1 bonds.

title: NPS KYC Update: Seafarers Allowed CDC Not Older Than 6 Months
description: PFRDA allows NRI seafarers to use a CDC not older than 6 months for NPS Tier I KYC, easing address proof requirements.

title: FGLOC pushes RBI for SRO status to organise ₹5‑6 lakh crore gold‑loan NBFC sector
description: FGLOC seeks RBI SRO status to organize the ₹5-6 lakh crore gold-loan NBFC sector within the larger ₹19-20 lakh crore market.

title: SEBI reviews margin trading proposals as NSE eyes 23.5‑hour trading
description: SEBI reviews margin trading proposals as NSE International Exchange announces a 23.5-hour trading day amid cyber risk discussions.

title: Bombay HC quashes ICICI Bank sanction on Rs 3,250 crore Videocon loan case
description: Bombay High Court overturns ICICI Bank's sanction against ex-CEO Chanda Kochhar over the Rs 3,250 crore 2012 Videocon loan that became an NPA.

title: Groww stake sale: Kotak MF, BlackRock lead Rs 1,905 crore buy
description: Kotak MF and BlackRock bought 8.70 crore Groww shares for Rs 1,905 crore, a 1.38% stake, lifting Kotak MF's holding to 2.21%.

title: RBI warns Yes Bank AT1 write-off reversal undermines rescue rules
description: RBI filed a review petition arguing the Supreme Court's order to restore Rs 8,415 crore in Yes Bank AT1 bonds conflicts with Basel III regulations.

title: Assetz IPO gets SEBI nod, aims to raise Rs 1,200 crore in Bengaluru
description: Assetz Ltd secured SEBI clearance on 17 November to pursue an IPO aiming to raise Rs 1,200 crore in Bengaluru within the next 18 months.

title: Paytm slides 7% to ₹1,765.05 as RBI delays UPI merchant discount rollout
description: Paytm shares fell 7% to ₹1,765.05 and Pine Labs dropped 5.4% to ₹160.05 after reports that the RBI may delay the UPI merchant discount rollout.

title: UPI fee delay pushes Paytm, Pine Labs shares down 6%
description: UPI fee delay on payments above Rs 2,000 pushed Paytm and Pine Labs shares down 6% and 3.7% respectively, sending payment stocks lower.

title: IRDAI to form two working groups in 10 days for real‑time health claims tracking
description: IRDAI will create two industry working groups within 10 days to enable real‑time health claim tracking and set standard performance metrics...

title: IRDAI to form two working groups within 10 days to boost health claim transparency
description: IRDAI will create two working groups within 10 days to improve health insurance claim transparency and standardise rejection reasons.

title: SEBI launches capacity‑building network for independent directors
description: SEBI introduces a capacity‑building network to equip independent directors with continuous learning on cyber, data and AI risks.

title: Razorpay eyes $600 million IPO raise, could list by February 2027
description: Razorpay plans to file for an IPO next week, aiming to raise up to $600 million. The Bengaluru-based fintech targets a listing by February 2027.

title: Amazon, Meesho, Swiggy, Zepto & Eternal Unite to Launch Digital Commerce Coalition in India
description: Amazon, Eternal, Meesho, Swiggy and Zepto launch India's Digital Commerce Coalition to boost e‑commerce, MSME growth and delivery partner welfare.

title: HSBC to cut jobs as part of its ongoing restructuring initiative
description: HSBC will cut investment banking jobs in Europe, the UK and the Americas, winding down equity capital markets to save $3 billion and focus on Asia.

title: DMart’s Big Shift: Faster Expansion Fuels a Sharp Market Comeback
description: DMart's stock jumps 30% as it shifts to a lease-driven, faster store expansion, adding 58 stores in Q4 FY26 and boosting market confidence.

title: Adani Green Powers Ahead: Profit Jumps 34% as Capacity Expansion Fuels Growth
description: Adani Green Energy's Q4 FY26 profit rose 34.3% to Rs 514 cr, revenue 16% to Rs 3,094 cr, adding 5.1 GW for a 19.3 GW portfolio.

title: ECOS (India) Mobility IPO Allotment: How to Check Your Application Status, GMP, and Listing Date
description: ECOS (India) Mobility IPO, oversubscribed 64.26×, will list on BSE/NSE on Sep 4 after allotment on Sep 2, with status checks via GMP.

title: NSE IPO Turning Point: Why the April 27 Deadline Could Change Everything
description: The NSE IPO's April 27, 2026 EOI deadline marks a turning point, as shareholder participation will signal confidence and shape the listing outcome.

title: OnEMI Technology IPO Set to Open April 30: Key Details Investors Should Know
description: OnEMI Technology Solutions launches a ₹925 crore IPO on April 30, 2026 with a ₹162‑₹171 price band, issuing fresh equity and an OFS to fund expansion.

title: Energy Crisis Hits Hard : 400+ Ceramic Factories Shut, Thousands of Workers Affected
description: Gas shortages from West Asia conflict forced 400+ Indian ceramic factories to shut, halting production and leaving thousands of workers jobless.

title: Gala Precision Engineering Marks Strong Market Debut, Shares Open with 42% Premium
description: Gala Precision Engineering debuted Sep 9, 2024, listing at a 41.78% premium on BSE (Rs 750) and 36.31% on NSE (Rs 721.10) after a 201‑times IPO.

title: NSE Sees Surge in Demat Accounts in FY25, Powered by Groww and Zerodha
description: NSE added over 84 lakh new active demat accounts in FY25, a 20.5% YoY rise, driven mainly by Groww (40% share), Angel One and Zerodha.
